# GSR Logistics

> GSR Logistics (Tashkent, Uzbekistan) ships cargo from China to Uzbekistan — consolidated truck cargo from the Yiwu warehouse via Khorgos to Tashkent in roughly 15–25 days, air cargo in 5–10 days, rail and containers in 20–35 days — and handles product sourcing, buying on 1688/Taobao/Alibaba, industrial equipment import, customs clearance and photo-reported quality control in China. Minimum shipment: consolidated truck cargo is accepted from 1 m³ per shipment — pieces from several sellers are combined under one GS code — and nothing smaller is carried by truck; cargo under 1 m³ can go by air, from 0.5 kg. Rail takes full containers only (20GP, 40GP, 40HQ and other types); there is no consolidated cargo by rail. The buying service takes orders with a total volume of at least 1 m³, whichever platform (1688, Taobao, Pinduoduo, Alibaba); no single items. Three receiving addresses in China: Yiwu 义乌, Guangzhou 广州 and Kashgar 喀什 — your manager tells you which one applies. Working with China since 2018. New direction: GSR Logistics now also carries cargo to Afghanistan by truck — from China in transit through Uzbekistan, or from Uzbekistan — as a full truck or as consolidated cargo, delivered to the Hairatan border crossing or to Mazar-i-Sharif; it prepares transit documents for cargo crossing Uzbekistan (the transit declaration is filed by its own customs broker; CMR and TIR documents; help obtaining permits for foreign trucks; meeting the truck at the border; help with security for customs payments) and allocates space in a partner's warehouse under customs control in Tashkent, with transshipment truck to truck or through the warehouse — prices and transit times for these three services are on request, by WhatsApp (+998 90 175 78 00) or Telegram, and the published tariffs and the calculator apply to China → Tashkent only. Legal entity: Imex services LLC. Office: 27 Alisher Navoiy St., Tashkent. Phone +998 95 018 33 33 and +998 90 175 78 00 (WhatsApp on the second number). E-mail b.e.kodirov@gmail.com. Telegram: https://t.me/gsrlogistics (channel), https://t.me/gsrgroupchat (group), https://t.me/bekzodkodirov556 (company account). Instagram https://instagram.com/gsrgroup.uz, Facebook https://facebook.com/gsrlogistics — on social media the brand also appears as GSR Group. Office hours Mon–Sat 9:00–19:00; address Toshkent, Shayxontohur tumani, Alisher Navoiy koʻchasi 27, 100011 (Yandex Maps https://yandex.uz/maps/org/98882247475/, Google Maps https://www.google.com/maps?cid=14536427051693213311). Figures: 50–100 containers a month China → Tashkent, 400+ clients, the team has 15 years of experience in freight. Tracking: a QR code on every carton is scanned by staff at each stage and the client watches those scans in the Telegram bot @GSR_GROUP_AGENT_bot (not GPS, not a live location). Languages: Uzbek Latin (default, /), Russian (/ru/), English (/en/), Uzbek Cyrillic (/kirill/ — the same site in Cyrillic script), Chinese (Simplified, /zh/) and Persian (/fa/) — see below.
> Oʻzbekcha: GSR Logistics — Xitoydan Oʻzbekistonga yigʻma yuk (avto kargo) 15–25 kun, avia kargo 5–10 kun, temir yoʻl va konteyner 20–35 kun; tovar topish, 1688/Taobaoʼdan sotib olish, uskunalar importi, bojxona rasmiylashtiruvi, Ivu omborida sifat nazorati va foto-hisobot. Yigʻma yuk kamida 1 m³ dan qabul qilinadi (kichikroq yuk — faqat avia, 0,5 kg dan); temir yoʻl — faqat butun konteyner (20GP, 40GP, 40HQ va boshqa turlar), temir yoʻlda yigʻma yuk yoʻq; sotib olish — umumiy hajmi 1 m³ dan boshlanadigan buyurtmalar. Xitoyda uchta qabul manzili: Ivu, Guanchjou va Qashqar. Qaysi biriga joʻnatish kerakligini menejer aytadi. Toshkent, 2018-yildan. Yangi yoʻnalish: Afgʻonistonga fura bilan yuk tashiymiz — Xitoydan (Oʻzbekiston orqali tranzit tartibida) va Oʻzbekistondan, butun fura yoki yigʻma yuk, Hayraton chegara postigacha yoki Mozori Sharifgacha; Oʻzbekiston orqali tranzit hujjatlarini rasmiylashtiramiz va Toshkentda hamkorimizning bojxona nazoratidagi omboridan joy ajratamiz; bu xizmatlarda narx va muddat — soʻrov boʻyicha (WhatsApp +998 90 175 78 00 yoki Telegram).
> Русский: GSR Logistics — сборные грузы из Китая в Узбекистан 15–25 дней, авиа 5–10 дней, ж/д и контейнеры 20–35 дней; поиск и выкуп товаров (1688/Taobao), импорт оборудования, растаможка, проверка и фотоотчёт на складе в Иу. Сборный груз — от 1 м³ (меньше — только авиа, от 0,5 кг); ж/д — только целые контейнеры (20GP, 40GP, 40HQ и другие типы), сборного груза по ж/д нет; выкуп — заказы общим объёмом от 1 м³. В Китае три адреса приёма: Иу, Гуанчжоу и Кашгар. На какой отправлять — скажет менеджер. Ташкент, с 2018 года. Новое направление: возим грузы фурами в Афганистан — из Китая (транзитом через Узбекистан) и из Узбекистана, целой фурой или сборным грузом, до пограничного перехода Хайратон или до Мазари-Шарифа; оформляем транзитные документы в Узбекистане и выделяем место на складе партнёра под таможенным контролем в Ташкенте; цена и срок по этим услугам — по запросу (WhatsApp +998 90 175 78 00 или Telegram).

## Services (uz / ru / en)
- [Avto kargo (yigʻma yuk)](https://gsrlogistics.uz/xizmatlar/avto-kargo/): consolidated truck cargo China → Tashkent, priced per m³ by cargo density, from 1 m³ per shipment, 15–25 days · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/uslugi/avto-kargo/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/services/truck-cargo/)
- [Avia kargo](https://gsrlogistics.uz/xizmatlar/avia-kargo/): air cargo 5–10 days for urgent and high-value goods · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/uslugi/avia-kargo/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/services/air-cargo/)
- [Temir yoʻl va konteyner](https://gsrlogistics.uz/xizmatlar/temir-yol-konteyner/): full containers only (FCL: 20GP, 40GP, 40HQ and other types), no consolidated cargo by rail, 20–35 days · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/uslugi/zhd-konteyner/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/services/rail-container/)
- [Tovar va ishlab chiqaruvchi topish](https://gsrlogistics.uz/xizmatlar/tovar-topish/): product and factory sourcing in China, samples, negotiation · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/uslugi/poisk-tovarov/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/services/sourcing/)
- [1688 va Taobaoʼdan sotib olish](https://gsrlogistics.uz/xizmatlar/sotib-olish/): buying agent for 1688, Taobao, Pinduoduo, Alibaba; orders from 1 m³ total volume, payment in yuan · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/uslugi/vykup-tovarov/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/services/buying-agent/)
- [Uskunalar importi](https://gsrlogistics.uz/xizmatlar/uskunalar-importi/): turnkey industrial equipment import · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/uslugi/import-oborudovaniya/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/services/equipment-import/)
- [Bojxona rasmiylashtiruvi](https://gsrlogistics.uz/xizmatlar/bojxona/): customs clearance in Uzbekistan, duty and VAT calculation, documents · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/uslugi/tamozhnya/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/services/customs/)
- [Xitoyda ombor va sifat nazorati](https://gsrlogistics.uz/xizmatlar/ombor-sifat-nazorati/): Yiwu warehouse plus receiving points in Guangzhou and Kashgar, consolidation, inspection, photo report, packing, insurance · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/uslugi/sklad-proverka/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/services/warehouse-quality-control/)
- [Avtomobil va elektromobil](https://gsrlogistics.uz/xizmatlar/avtomobil-importi/): cars and EVs from China to order · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/uslugi/avto-iz-kitaya/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/services/car-import/)
- [Afgʻonistonga yuk tashish](https://gsrlogistics.uz/xizmatlar/afgonistonga-yuk-tashish/): cargo to Afghanistan by truck — from China (received in Yiwu, through Kazakhstan, then in transit through Uzbekistan) or from Uzbekistan; a full truck or consolidated cargo; delivered to the Hairatan border crossing or to Mazar-i-Sharif; on the Afghan side customs is cleared by partner customs agents (declarants); price and transit time on request · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/uslugi/gruzy-v-afganistan/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/services/cargo-to-afghanistan/)
- [Oʻzbekiston orqali tranzit hujjatlari](https://gsrlogistics.uz/xizmatlar/tranzit-hujjatlari/): transit documents for cargo crossing Uzbekistan — the transit declaration filed by GSR's own customs broker, CMR and TIR documents, help obtaining permits for foreign trucks, meeting the truck at the border, help with security for customs payments; price on request · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/uslugi/tranzitnye-dokumenty/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/services/transit-documents/)
- [Toshkentda bojxona nazoratidagi ombor](https://gsrlogistics.uz/xizmatlar/bojxona-ombori/): space in a partner's warehouse under customs control in Tashkent, and transshipment truck to truck or through the warehouse; price and storage terms agreed for each cargo · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/uslugi/tamozhennyj-sklad/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/services/customs-warehouse-tashkent/)

## Pricing & calculator
- [Narxlar](https://gsrlogistics.uz/narxlar/): truck rates per m³ by cargo density (110–320 $/m³, and 0.55 $/kg above 1000 kg/m³), air rates per kg with the ÷5000 volumetric rule, inclusions, extras, payment · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/ceny/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/pricing/)
- [Kalkulyator](https://gsrlogistics.uz/kalkulyator/): instant estimate by weight, volume and mode · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/kalkulyator/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/calculator/)
- [Kuzatuv](https://gsrlogistics.uz/kuzatuv/): cargo tracking by code and status glossary · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/otslezhivanie/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/tracking/)

## Guides
- [Qoʻllanma](https://gsrlogistics.uz/qollanma/): guides on shipping from China, how cargo prices are calculated, air vs truck vs rail, ordering from 1688, Uzbekistan customs duties 2026, finding a supplier, Yiwu and Guangzhou markets, prohibited goods, cargo glossary, China–Tashkent routes; and two guides on the new direction — how cargo from China travels to Afghanistan through Uzbekistan, and which documents road transit through Uzbekistan needs · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/gid/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/guides/)
- [Xitoydan Afgʻonistonga yuk: Oʻzbekiston orqali](https://gsrlogistics.uz/qollanma/xitoydan-afgonistonga-yuk/): guide — how cargo from China travels to Afghanistan by truck: received in Yiwu, through Kazakhstan, then across Uzbekistan under customs transit to the Termez–Hairatan crossing; handover at Hairatan or in Mazar-i-Sharif; a full truck or consolidated cargo; the documents and who handles them in Uzbekistan (the transit declaration is filed by GSR's own customs broker); on the Afghan side, customs clearance by partner customs agents (declarants); payment through a bank that works between Uzbekistan and Afghanistan, under a contract between the client and GSR; the client follows the cargo through GSR's ERP system, in Telegram; price and timing on request · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/gid/gruz-iz-kitaya-v-afganistan-cherez-uzbekistan/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/guides/cargo-from-china-to-afghanistan-via-uzbekistan/) · [中文](https://gsrlogistics.uz/zh/guides/cargo-from-china-to-afghanistan-via-uzbekistan/) · [فارسی](https://gsrlogistics.uz/fa/guides/cargo-from-china-to-afghanistan-via-uzbekistan/)
- [Oʻzbekiston orqali tranzit: hujjatlar va tartib](https://gsrlogistics.uz/qollanma/ozbekiston-orqali-tranzit/): guide — road transit through Uzbekistan by truck: what customs transit is; the documents a truck needs; the transit declaration — who files it and when (GSR's own customs broker files it) — and when none is needed; CMR and TIR; permits (dozvol) for foreign trucks; customs escort and security for customs payments; the law's maximum terms and fees (legal maximums, not transit times); reloading and storage on the way under customs control; how transit ends; the price of GSR's own service on request · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/gid/tranzit-cherez-uzbekistan-dokumenty/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/guides/transit-through-uzbekistan-documents/) · [中文](https://gsrlogistics.uz/zh/guides/transit-through-uzbekistan-documents/) · [فارسی](https://gsrlogistics.uz/fa/guides/transit-through-uzbekistan-documents/)
- [Savol-javob](https://gsrlogistics.uz/savol-javob/): 41 customer questions with direct answers, among them six on Afghanistan, transit documents and the warehouse under customs control · [ru](https://gsrlogistics.uz/ru/faq/) · [en](https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/faq/)

## Oʻzbekcha (kirill) — Ўзбекча, кирилл
Every page above also exists in Uzbek Cyrillic under /kirill/, with a Cyrillic slug. It is the Uzbek
content transliterated script-for-script — same facts, same prices, same dates — and each page names
its Latin twin in hreflang (uz-Latn ⇄ uz-Cyrl), so the two are one page in two scripts, not two
offers. URLs are written here in Cyrillic for reading; a browser sends them percent-encoded, and that
escaped form is what https://gsrlogistics.uz/sitemap-0.xml carries.
- [Бош саҳифа](https://gsrlogistics.uz/kirill/) — home
- [Хизматлар](https://gsrlogistics.uz/kirill/хизматлар/) — the twelve services, each at /kirill/хизматлар/<slug>/
- [Нархлар](https://gsrlogistics.uz/kirill/нархлар/) — prices · [Калькулятор](https://gsrlogistics.uz/kirill/калькулятор/) · [Кузатув](https://gsrlogistics.uz/kirill/кузатув/) — tracking
- [Қўлланма](https://gsrlogistics.uz/kirill/қўлланма/) — the twelve guides, each at /kirill/қўлланма/<slug>/ · [Савол-жавоб](https://gsrlogistics.uz/kirill/савол-жавоб/) — FAQ
- [Биз ҳақимизда](https://gsrlogistics.uz/kirill/биз-ҳақимизда/) — about · [Алоқа](https://gsrlogistics.uz/kirill/алоқа/) — contact · [Махфийлик](https://gsrlogistics.uz/kirill/махфийлик/) — privacy · [Ишларимиз](https://gsrlogistics.uz/kirill/ишларимиз/) — videos and photos of our work

## Chinese (中文, /zh/) and Persian (فارسی, /fa/)
The site is also published in Simplified Chinese under /zh/ (hreflang zh-Hans) and in Persian under /fa/
(hreflang fa, right to left). Both are translations of the English pages and keep the English slugs:
https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/pricing/ is https://gsrlogistics.uz/zh/pricing/ and https://gsrlogistics.uz/fa/pricing/;
https://gsrlogistics.uz/en/services/truck-cargo/ is https://gsrlogistics.uz/zh/services/truck-cargo/ and
https://gsrlogistics.uz/fa/services/truck-cargo/. Each page names its translations in hreflang and in the sitemap.
A translation changes the language, not the offer: the same twelve services — cargo from China to Uzbekistan and
the work around it, and the new truck service to Afghanistan with transit documents and the warehouse under customs
control in Tashkent — the same figures, and managers who speak Uzbek, Russian and Chinese. Write to us in Persian
or Dari — we answer in Persian with the help of a translator; we also answer in English, Russian and Uzbek.
- [中文](https://gsrlogistics.uz/zh/) — Chinese home · [فارسی](https://gsrlogistics.uz/fa/) — Persian home
- Cargo to Afghanistan, transit documents and the warehouse under customs control, in Persian (for readers in Afghanistan): [حمل بار به افغانستان](https://gsrlogistics.uz/fa/services/cargo-to-afghanistan/) · [اسناد ترانزیت در ازبکستان](https://gsrlogistics.uz/fa/services/transit-documents/) · [انبار تحت نظارت گمرک در تاشکند](https://gsrlogistics.uz/fa/services/customs-warehouse-tashkent/)
- The same three services in Chinese: [阿富汗货运](https://gsrlogistics.uz/zh/services/cargo-to-afghanistan/) · [乌兹别克斯坦过境单证](https://gsrlogistics.uz/zh/services/transit-documents/) · [塔什干海关监管仓库](https://gsrlogistics.uz/zh/services/customs-warehouse-tashkent/)
